# Website Traffic Trend for a Nonprofit

A **line chart** is the best choice here because the data is monthly and time-based, so it shows the rise, dip, and recovery in traffic clearly. A **column chart** also works well if the team wants to emphasize month-to-month volume, but the line chart is strongest for trend reading.

## Monthly Traffic Pattern and Key Takeaways

| Month | Visits |
|---|---:|
| Jan | 1,200 |
| Feb | 1,350 |
| Mar | 1,500 |
| Apr | 1,420 |
| May | 1,680 |
| Jun | 1,900 |

- Traffic increased overall from **1,200** in January to **1,900** in June, a gain of **700 visits**.
- The trend is mostly upward, with a small dip in **April** before rebounding strongly in **May** and **June**.
- The largest jump appears between **April and May**.
- This pattern suggests improving reach or campaign effectiveness over time, with one short interruption in spring.

## Dashboard Metrics That Would Add Fundraising Value

- **Donation conversion rate**: percentage of website visitors who complete a donation.
- **Average gift value**: helps the team understand not just how many people donate, but how much each donation contributes.

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Add dashboard metrics] https://www.google.com/search?q=nonprofit+fundraising+dashboard+metrics

## Sources

- Chart guidance for time-series data: https://www.datawrapper.de/blog/line-chart-vs-bar-chart/
- Nonprofit analytics concepts: https://www.classy.org/blog/nonprofit-metrics/
